title: Yellow Spicy Thai Sausages Khanom Krok
description: A funky and snappy Thai dish featuring sausages, infuse-oil, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, formed into khanom krok, this recipe is a nostalgic treat from Isaan cuisine.

ingredients.name: Thai sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably homemade or store-bought with no added preservatives

instructions: Preheat the khanom krok pan over medium heat and brush with infuse oil.
In a large bowl, mix together rice flour, water, salt, sugar, and coconut milk to form a smooth batter.
Add sliced Thai chili peppers and chopped cilantro to the batter and stir well.
Pour about 1 tablespoon of the batter into each khanom krok mold.
Place a Thai sausage in the center of each mold.
Cover the sausage with another tablespoon of the batter.
Cook for 4-5 minutes or until the edges start to brown.
Flip the khanom krok and cook for another 4 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a squeeze of lime juice and a side of sweet chili sauce.
